content:
Overview

Toulon is a city in Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur with a population of 176,000. A major Mediterranean naval port with a stunning harbor, beautiful beaches, and the majestic Mont Faron overlooking the city. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 275 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
